newsitem.title: USA: TeleSpectrum sees better results in H2.
newsitem.headline: TeleSpectrum sees better results in H2.

text.p: TeleSpectrum Worldwide Inc said Tuesday it expects improved performance for the rest of the year after posting a second quarter loss.
The company said an aggressive expansion of capacity was largely the reason for its loss of $0.02 per share versus a profit of $0.08 per share on a pro forma basis a year ago.

"With better utilization of our new, state-of-the-art call centers, a continued focus on strengthening the company, and a strong effort to cut costs, we expect our performance to improve in the third and fourth quarters of this year," chairman and chief executive Brian O'Neill said.
